fficients look like overfitting rather than the true law, so I did not submit them.

The submitted candidate uses only 10 parameters, so it dropped the cubic spring term and the v·cos forcing term. That loss is why it is so much worse than the 1.9e-4 fit I had in analysis before the parameter limit.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    a, w = params[0], params[1]
    e = np.exp(a*t)
    return (params[2] + params[3]*x + params[4]*v + params[5]*v*np.abs(v)
            + e*(params[6]*np.cos(w*t) + params[7]*np.sin(w*t))
            + params[8]*t + params[9]*t*v)
